name: whisper-podlodka-turbo
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.809 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-06-22. Caveats: WER wins are modest on the in-domain set (8.17 vs 8.33 on podlodka_speech, 5.22 vs 6.63 on CV11) and large on farfield (11.61 vs 20.12). Russian. The VAD F1 row comes from a separate table measuring the same two checkpoints, not the ASR benchmark. Robust-ASR and long-form tables exist on the card but were not promoted (chunking variants, not distinct benchmarks).
